name: Flatcap (Reclaimed Denim, Re-blocked)
description: A flat cap cut and re-blocked from salvaged denim, its original indigo faded to a pale, uneven blue-grey with a darker sweat-stain ring at the inner band. The brim is stiffened with a strip of peel-and-stick repair board; the seam at the crown has been re-stitched in thick white thread. Simple, functional, keeps the rain off your face.
functionality: Blocks light rain and lake wind from the face; sweat-band lining absorbs moisture during labor.
what_it_says: Handmade and worn without apology — this person shapes what they have into what they need.
story_hooks: A small symbol is inked in ballpoint pen just inside the brim — a mark of ownership or a ward, hard to tell which.
Flatcaps like this are sometimes made and sold by a blind elder in Shelf Block 14 who charges whatever you can spare.
